communities.name: Abua Central

history.text: Headquarters of Abua–Odual LGA. The LGA article says the people of Abua are of Ijaw ancestry.

communities.note: The Ijaw-ancestry claim in the LGA article needs checking against the language classification used for this group.

summary.text: The Abua live in Abua/Odual LGA of Rivers State and speak a Central Delta language, related to Ogbia and Odual.
